summary: Iteration 6 backend testing complete. Verified 3 NEW endpoints (GET /admin/leads/analytics, POST /admin/leads/auto-qualify, POST /admin/leads/{id}/qualify) and the critical route-ordering refactor. All 34 pytest tests pass (21 iter-5 regression + 13 new). Qualifier correctly returns either llm or fallback shape; analytics returns full funnel+rates+outreach_7d+top_sources+top_subreddits; persistence verified via create→GET follow-up; dynamic /{lead_id} route still resolves correctly for valid UUIDs without capturing literal routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering is correctly maintained in /app/backend/lead_engine_routes.py — literal routes (discover-now, import, auto-qualify, analytics) are declared BEFORE the dynamic /{lead_id} route. A comment documents this invariant.
llm_qualify has a robust deterministic fallback — score clamped 0..100, string fields length-capped, qualifier tag always set to 'llm' or 'fallback'.
auto_qualify_all_discovered iterates with per-lead try/except — one bad lead won't abort the batch (good).
outreach_analytics uses correct Mongo $match on subreddit existence + $ne null, so legacy non-reddit leads don't pollute top_subreddits.

Minor: outreach_analytics computes reply_rate_pct = replied/contacted but funnel 'replied' count includes qualified+booked via $in — this is intentional (cumulative funnel) but worth documenting in the response so FE doesn't mis-label.
Minor: auto-qualify endpoint silently clamps limit/min_score from payload but does not validate non-int types (e.g. {'limit': 'abc'} would 500). Pydantic model would be cleaner.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_lead_engine.py (added TestNewEndpointsAuth, TestAnalytics, TestQualifyOne, TestAutoQualify, TestRouteOrdering — 13 new tests)
seed_data_creation: Each test imports its own TEST_ prefixed lead (uuid-suffixed source_id) — no shared fixtures pollute DB. Some leads remain in DB as regression fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full 34-test pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lead_engine.py and covers all /api/admin/leads/* routes + analytics + qualifier + route ordering + cross-post fallback. In current env EMERGENT_LLM_KEY returns empty, so qualifier=='fallback' with score==signal_score is expected (tests accept either 'llm' or 'fallback'). Frontend smoke was NOT tested this iteration — main agent stated they verified manually. If retesting FE, check AdminLogin (#bebebe base + lime), AdminDashboard (telemetry strip + dark screen cluster), AdminLeadEngine (score batteries + analytics row + AI Qualify button + drawer qualifier section).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Route ordering works as intended: FastAPI matches routes in declaration order, so the literal /admin/leads/analytics, /auto-qualify, /discover-now, /import all resolve to their handlers before the dynamic /{lead_id} catch-all.
